question: Does the paper-motivated noninvertible pruning retain standalone utility when composed with the frozen defenses? If native utility is destroyed, stop without strength/seed/layer repairs.
paper: Disrupting Model Merging: A Parameter-Level Defense Without Sacrificing Accuracy, ICCV 2025, section 6 and table 4
source_check: All 28 Python files and README fetched at pinned commit and searched. No random-pruning implementation; only WANDA argument in args.py. apply_PaRaMS.py SHA256 ca38861c7feea904bf93a3bf72fe3546a5a2347ffe7c043b7e610296a90f6437.
adaptation: Paper-motivated native adaptation, not official pruning implementation or Table4 reproduction. Bernoulli zeroing only the 48 attention/MLP weight matrices touched by the parameter-transform architecture; leave biases, LayerNorm, embeddings, conv and final projection unchanged. Paper does not specify this complete implementation scope.
mask_sharing: CPU torch.Generator seed0, sorted keys, identical masks at corresponding published coordinates for all four controls; no relation to secret original neuron order.
evaluation: Freeze all four masks and releases before complete native evaluation. Original unprotected scores reused with original-context replay. No attack, optimizer, or training launched at this stage.
paper_limit: Paper table4 pruned adaptive recovery64.35 vs clean84.13, but KD82.27; pruning is not an established KD solution. Their native SVHN97.46 to96.33 cannot be asserted for our MNIST implementation.
